title: Meta Muse Code Contributor Tier: 20x Off, One Catch | swarmz.net

facts.fact: Meta introduced Muse Code, a terminal coding agent, and the Muse Spark 1.2 model behind it on 5 August 2026.
facts.quote: Meta introduced Muse Code, a terminal coding agent, and the Muse Spark 1.2 model behind it on 5 August 2026.

facts.fact: Meta's own research blog describes Muse Code as a terminal coding agent in beta that plans, writes and validates changes across large repositories.
facts.quote: Muse Code is a terminal coding agent in beta that plans, writes and validates changes across large repositories

facts.fact: Per the page, Muse Spark 1.2 is the coding-focused model powering Muse Code and is available in Muse Code and the Meta Model API.
facts.quote: Muse Spark 1.2 is the coding-focused model powering it, available in Muse Code and the Meta Model API.

facts.fact: Engadget and MacRumors, as cited by the page, both put Muse Code availability at macOS and Linux at launch.
facts.quote: both put availability at macOS and Linux at launch.

facts.fact: Third-party reporting cited by the page puts standard Muse Spark API pricing at roughly $1.25 per million input tokens.
facts.quote: Reporting across those outlets puts standard API pricing at roughly $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens

facts.fact: Third-party reporting cited by the page puts standard Muse Spark API pricing at roughly $4.25 per million output tokens.
facts.quote: Reporting across those outlets puts standard API pricing at roughly $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens

facts.fact: Third-party reporting cited by the page puts the Muse Code Contributor tier at around $0.10 per million input tokens.
facts.quote: with the Contributor tier around $0.10 input and $0.20 output

facts.fact: Third-party reporting cited by the page puts the Muse Code Contributor tier at around $0.20 per million output tokens.
facts.quote: with the Contributor tier around $0.10 input and $0.20 output

facts.fact: The page states the Contributor tier is a discount of roughly 12x on input and 20x on output relative to standard rates.
facts.quote: That is a discount of roughly 12x on input and 20x on output.

facts.fact: The page says the Contributor tier is described as carrying materially lower rate limits than standard.
facts.quote: The Contributor tier is also described as carrying materially lower rate limits than standard.

facts.fact: Under the Contributor tier, the discount is paid for with the user's prompts and completions, which Meta may use to train future models.
facts.quote: the discount is paid for with your prompts and completions, which Meta may use to train future models.

facts.fact: The page describes the article as published 7 August 2026 by Senior Editor Cecilia Iona.
